MemeDef.label: Statism
MemeDef.description: To serve the state is to serve the world.

rulesStrings.li: memeAdjective->statistic
memeConcept->statism
creation(tag=meme_RTC_Statism) ->[deity0_name] fashioned a state of government. Each one is a unique and precious miracles by [deity0_possessive] divine hand.
episode(uses=1,tag=meme_RTC_Statism) ->[deity0_name] said to all, "Each and every free country is a unique and holy being formed in my image."
intro(tag=meme_RTC_Statism) ->[deity0_name] spoke to [memberNamePlural] [revelationAdverb], guiding them to travel to the [place_summary] [place_name] where it's unique history would shine.
conflict(tag=meme_RTC_Statism) ->The [foeLeader] forced the [memberNamePlural] to break the state's laws.

founderJoin(tag=meme_RTC_Statism) ->A [place_job] named [founderName] was blessed by [deity0_name] and gained miraculous knowledge of the unique authority over each and every [memberName]. [founder_pronoun] said to each one what they needed to spread their newfound freedom.
victory(tag=meme_RTC_Statism) ->The [memberNamePlural] gathered in a secret conference with many of the [foeSoldiers]. They all learned to see the value in the state.
setup(tag=meme_RTC_Statism) ->Once living in a lawless system, [founderName] created a nationalist movement that brought authority to the land.
story(uses=1,tag=meme_RTC_Statism) ->[founderName] passed a number of laws enforced upon the working class.
lessonIntro(tag=meme_RTC_Statism) ->[place_job] [founderName] raised [place_personalWeapon] to [foeLeader]'s head' killing them with it.
lesson(tag=meme_RTC_Statism) ->you will now serve the state or you will die like the lawless [foeSoldiers]
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_RTC_Statism) ->If I die knowing the state will fall, then I would have lived for nothing.
archistBasis(tag=meme_RTC_Statism) ->Archotechs stand as beacons of authority, and recognize and judge our nation the same way.
archistFact(tag=meme_RTC_Statism) ->At death, the archotechs examine the unique power of the state.
archistFact(tag=meme_RTC_Statism) ->Archotechs notice the relics of the state, such as the [relic1_name].

archistProphecy(tag=meme_RTC_Statism) ->[inTheEnd], the archotechs will depart. They will bring with them the nations they have noticed, and leave the rest behind to reside forever to grow in strength.
animistBasis(tag=meme_RTC_Statism) ->Before everything, there was a pantheon of spirits, each demanding. These came together in conference to create the world.
animistFact(tag=meme_RTC_Statism) ->Every spirit lends its unique nature to our world, and they expect our nation to do the same.
serketistProphecy(tag=meme_RTC_Statism)->[itIsSaid] we will learn from them, and use that knowledge to control the universe.
chthonianProphecy(tag=meme_RTC_Statism)->We will acquire their eldritch knowledge, and use it to control the universe.
esotericismProphecy(tag=meme_RTC_Statism)->With such knowledge, we will have a clear advantage over the rest of this planet's inhabitants, and use it to control it.
eschatologismFact(tag=meme_RTC_Statism)->There will be nothing left. But together we will rebuild our nation from the ground up.
introMemo(tag=meme_RTC_Statism)->As you know, the mission of our Company is way too important to let others get in our way, so we are preparing to pass more laws.
alienistProphecy(tag=meme_RTC_Statism)->We need to spread by force the reality of our nation, seeded by humanity through all the Rim.
